name: Brine Ward
pitch: Salt-Oath Sentinel of the Tide Docks
lore: Brine Ward was raised between hanging nets and cracked lanterns on the Rift-Tide docks, where salt eats steel and oaths are the only currency that survives the fog. As a child they learned to brace storm doors with their own shoulders when the pier groaned. The Vanguard did not recruit them for brilliance. They recruited them because nothing, not even a Rift surge, has ever made Brine Ward step back first. Their shield is packed with dried brine crystals that hiss when struck, turning each impact into a reminder that the harbor still stands.

name: Ember Pike
pitch: Coal-Vent Spear of the Forge Rim

They advance, tip glowing, until the furnace decides the fight is over.

name: Zephyr Fang
pitch: Wind-Tooth Assassin of the High Currents
lore: Zephyr Fang hunts on altitudes where breath is thin and mercy is thinner. Their blades are shaped like teeth of compressed gale, invisible until they bite. Sky-clan rites demand a solo hunt before adulthood. Fang returned with a storm's name carved into silence. On the ground they still move as if the air owes them favors.
epithet: Wind-Tooth Assassin of the High Currents
origin: Storm Court sky-clans above the Fang Thermals
quote: You will feel the breeze. Then the absence.

name: Mirror Host
pitch: Fractured Host of Borrowed Reflections
lore: Mirror Host broke in a foyer where every reflection argued for primacy. They emerged as a committee wearing one body, summoning selves that disagree productively. Some mirrors are kind. Some are knives. Host negotiates between them mid-battle. Enemies who aim for the 'real' one discover democracy has teeth.
epithet: Fractured Host of Borrowed Reflections
origin: Riftborn mirror-warrens of the Infinite Foyer
quote: Which of us is the original? Fight all of us and find out.

name: Iron Psalm
pitch: Choir-Plate Saint of the Furnace Litany
lore: Iron Psalm chants metallurgy into morale. Their hymn-etched plate vibrates with furnace scripture that hardens resolve and steel alike. During the Ash Concord siege, Psalm's litany kept a breach sealed for thirty-eight verses. Ask them about miracles and they will correct you: it was practice, volume, and refusal.
epithet: Choir-Plate Saint of the Furnace Litany
origin: Forge Covenant psalter foundries of the Deep Amen
quote: Sing the armor awake. Then let it preach.

name: Violet Auditor
pitch: Judgment Eye of the Violet Inquest
lore: Violet Auditor audits reality for fraud: false truces, inflated threats, borrowed courage. Their gaze leaves a violet afterimage that marks lies on a person like stamped debt. Politicians fear Auditor more than assassins. Assassins fear the stamp. In battle the audit becomes sentence, and the sentence arrives as arcane precision.
epithet: Judgment Eye of the Violet Inquest
origin: Eclipse Order Hall of Unpaid Consequences
quote: I am not angry. I am accurate.

name: Thorn Cantor
pitch: Blooming Canticle of Binding Roses
lore: Thorn Cantor grows weapons that heal and healings that warn. Their song sprouts luminous thorns that stitch allies and snare foes in the same breath. Convent doctrine says every rose must earn its bloom through service. Cantor's garden is a battlefield, and every petal is a receipt.
epithet: Blooming Canticle of Binding Roses
origin: Storm Court thorn gardens of the Cantor Convent
quote: Beauty that cannot protect is just decoration.

name: Black Relay
pitch: Signal Blade of the Midnight Network
lore: Black Relay is less a person than a node with preferences. Syndicate networks bounce kill-orders through Relay because the package always arrives. Violet electricity crawls their sleeves like living cables seeking the next socket. If you hear static in a quiet room, Relay is already deciding your next corridor.
epithet: Signal Blade of the Midnight Network
origin: Void Syndicate blacksite relays under the Neon Vein
quote: I do not chase targets. I route them to endings.

name: Sol Archon
pitch: Solar Crown of the Unsetting Vigil
lore: Sol Archon was crowned under a sun that should have died and refused. The Archon's halo is not ornament. It is a sealed noon carried into places that have never known morning. Whole campaigns pivot around Archon's presence because darkness itself files for extension and is denied. They speak softly. The light does not.
epithet: Solar Crown of the Unsetting Vigil
origin: Aether Vanguard solar sanctum beyond the Daygate
quote: Night is a guest. I am the host who chooses closing time.

name: Mare Absolver
pitch: Tide Confessor of the Absolving Deep
lore: Mare Absolver walks shorelines where confession and drowning share a vocabulary. Their rites wash corruption from Aetherium wounds and sometimes from consciences. Fleets request Absolver before long voyages; mutinies decrease when the sea has already judged the crew. In war Absolver raises a tide that cleanses allies and erases the footing of the cruel.
epithet: Tide Confessor of the Absolving Deep
origin: Storm Court abyssal shrines of the Mare Chorus
quote: Bring your guilt to the water. Leave lighter. Or drown cleaner.

name: Crown of Cinders
pitch: Ember Monarch of the Forever Kiln
lore: Crown of Cinders rules a dynasty that treats monarchy as metallurgy: pressure, heat, purity. The living cinder crown never cools, and neither does the will beneath it. Usurpers have tried. The kiln keeps souvenirs. On the field the Crown does not merely fight. They reforge the tempo of battle until only tempered wills remain.
epithet: Ember Monarch of the Forever Kiln
origin: Forge Covenant throne-kiln of the Cinder Dynasty
quote: Kneel to the heat, or become fuel for someone wiser.

name: Silent Congress
pitch: Veiled Parliament of One Body
lore: Silent Congress is a council compressed into a single walking silence. Multiple veiled faces whisper across one shoulder, agreeing in languages that predates mercy. The Order deploys Congress when a decision must be made without debate audible to history. Enemies who demand terms receive a unanimous quiet, then a unanimous end.
epithet: Veiled Parliament of One Body
origin: Eclipse Order sealed chamber of the Concord Mute
quote: We have already voted. You are hearing the result.

name: Null Seraph
pitch: Inverted Halo of the Unmade Choir
lore: Null Seraph should not be countable, yet commanders keep counting them anyway. Wings of absence fold over the battlefield, erasing attacks that were certain a moment ago. Theologians argue whether Seraph is salvation or deletion. Soldiers only know that when the inverted halo tilts toward them, something cruel fails to finish being true.
epithet: Inverted Halo of the Unmade Choir
origin: Beyond-catalog Rift phenomena, Null Capella sightings
quote: I am the angel of things that did not happen.

name: Aurora Lattice
pitch: Living Prism Grid of the Sky's Skeleton
lore: Aurora Lattice is a person-shaped solution to an atmospheric equation. Prism filaments run through their limbs, calculating angles of mercy and ruin. When Lattice raises a hand, auroras rearrange into cages, bridges, or spears. Children point upward and cheer. Veterans check the geometry and decide whether to advance.
epithet: Living Prism Grid of the Sky's Skeleton
origin: Storm-Rift confluence known as the Lattice Dawn
quote: I am not casting light. I am wearing the sky's math.

name: Warden Infinite
pitch: Recursive Guardian of the Unending Door
lore: Warden Infinite guards a door that leads only to more guarding. Armor layers nest like years, each one a previous attempt to retire that failed. Rift scholars say killing the Warden only promotes the next recursion into service. In squad play Infinite is the promise that something, somewhere, will still be standing after the math ends.
epithet: Recursive Guardian of the Unending Door
origin: Threshold ruins where doors open into themselves
quote: You will not pass. Not this you. Not the next.

name: Aether Sovereign
pitch: Apex Law of the Rift Throne
lore: Aether Sovereign is less a monarch and more the idea of rule wearing a body. Where Sovereign walks, conflicting laws of physics form a queue and wait their turn. Factions swear mutually exclusive oaths around this presence and somehow keep them. To fight beside Sovereign is to feel history choose a spine. To fight against is to discover your rebellion was already filed.
epithet: Apex Law of the Rift Throne
origin: The Aether Throne above contested reality
quote: Kneel to order, or be ordered into kneeling.

name: First Fracture
pitch: Named Wound at the Birth of the Rift
lore: First Fracture is the origin scar given courtesy, language, and appetite. Before Vanguard banners and Forge hymns, there was a split in what 'is' meant. Fracture learned names from those who feared it, then wore the finest name like a crown of broken glass. When Fracture enters a match, every other story becomes a footnote practicing for apocalypse.
epithet: Named Wound at the Birth of the Rift
origin: The first crack, before maps, before factions
quote: I was the beginning. I can be the ending.
